title: CompassDPO: Dynamics-Controlled DPO for Robust Safety Alignment

summary.claim: Noisy preference labels distort batch-level optimization. CompassDPO uses DPO's implicit reward margin to control update direction and size, giving stable safety alignment, especially under label noise.
summary.condition: PKU-SafeRLHF, four backbones, out-of-distribution safety benchmarks, label-flip noise; no external reward model.
summary.gap: (Inferred) Unreliable labels are judged only by the margin, so systematically biased labels (all wrong in the same direction) may still hurt.
